name: J.K. Cement Ltd.
about: J.K. Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement and its related products in India and internationally. The company offers grey cement products; JKMaxx paints, including interior and exterior emulsions, distemper, enamel, and primers; wall putty; and white cement. It also provides tile adhesives and grouts; and wood finishes, as well as construction chemicals solutions. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kanpur, India.
